title: Titan primary weapon sounds (Splitter, T-203, Railgun, Leadwall, Predator, hit confirms)
licensePolicy: CC0 1.0 and CC BY 4.0 recordings from individually checked Freesound or OpenGameArt pages, plus original synthesis from the build script (listed under synthLayers, no third-party audio). Entry "license" is the most restrictive licence among its sources. CC BY credits: CREDITS.txt, LICENSES.md, docs/audio/titan-sfx.md.
notes: Freesound items are the public HQ previews (Ogg Vorbis) because original downloads need a login; download_sha256 is the hash of that retrieved file. Build: tools/titan-sfx/ (recipes.py lists every cut). Gemini receives and listens to the audio (docs/audio/titan-weapons-judging.md); no human audition or audible in-game playback was performed.

files.format: Ogg Opus mono 48 kHz 96 kbit/s (libopus, bitexact)
